name: Café Royal
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Royal in Innsbruck – a historic café with over 100 years of tradition, located right in the heart of Innsbruck’s Old Town.
beschreibung: The Café Royal in Innsbruck is an elegant café and bar offering a stylish ambiance for coffee lovers and evening guests. During the day, it serves premium coffee specialties, fresh pastries, and light savory snacks. As the evening sets in, the venue transitions into a sophisticated lounge featuring an exquisite selection of wines, aperitifs, and creative cocktails. A chic meeting place in the provincial capital.
